gate_text: Does every candidate carry its admissibility screen, computed at every step -- ||V||_L3(R^3), the fitted far-field decay exponent, lambda, and an axisymmetry diagnostic -- and does the rigidity ledger (NRS/Tsai; Chae-Tsai; Pineau-Vicol) get machine-read rather than transcribed?
what_this_leg_screens: B6 (the layer that would produce a genuine periodic-orbit candidate) is user-gated and has not landed; B5's construction leg has not landed either (leg 353 ran only its novelty pass). This runner exercises the screen on leg 351's closed-form Type-I witness and leg 354's Galerkin trajectory built on it, at a ladder of checkpoints, plus a read-only contrast against leg 332's own landed L3 measurement.

lambda_diagnostic_on_landed_trajectory.reason: trajectory relaxes toward the trivial state Omega=0 rather than returning to a non-trivial periodic value (matches leg 354's landed B4 gate finding); no non-trivial period S0 was found, so lambda is UNDEFINED for this candidate

NRS_Tsai.reason: ||V||_L3(R^3) did NOT converge over the measured ladder (rel_change_last_step=0.1734965510122099 > tol 0.0001) -- the candidate is outside NRS/Tsai's hypothesis; the theorem is silent on it.

Chae_Tsai.verdict: CHAE-TSAI DOES NOT BITE. The theorem is SILENT on NS3D-DSS-NONAXI-LAMBDA-LARGE.
Chae_Tsai.clause_alpha_equation_reason: Every theorem hypothesises 'a time periodic solution of (1.6)', and (1.6) is the rescaled EULER system. The screened object solves Navier-Stokes. The authors' own reach remark extends the proof to arbitrary real constants a, b with b != 0, and NOT to the addition of -Laplacian V.

Pineau_Vicol.reason: no lambda was measured for this candidate (trajectory relaxes toward the trivial state Omega=0 rather than returning to a non-trivial periodic value (matches leg 354's landed B4 gate finding); no non-trivial period S0 was found, so lambda is UNDEFINED for this candidate); Pineau-Vicol's H5 hypothesis (1 < lambda < lambda_underline) cannot be evaluated without a measured lambda
